Keep the authoritative evaluator unchanged: preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, identical 200 users/category and 99 fixed unique negatives/user. Report each category’s HR@10 and their equally weighted mean. Sampled rankings can disagree with full-catalog rankings, so interpret improvements specifically under this benchmark ([Krichene and Rendle](https://arxiv.org/abs/1912.02263)). Recommended uncertainty analysis: retain paired per-user hit indicators; independently resample 200 users with replacement within each category, using identical sampled indices for both models; recompute the four-category macro difference for 10,000 replicates and report its 95% percentile interval. Pairing preserves the comparison on shared users ([SciPy bootstrap](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.bootstrap.html)). This estimates user-sampling uncertainty conditional on trained models and fixed candidates; it does not measure training-seed variability or correct selection bias.

Predeclare SASRec, last-item, uniform-history, and exponential-history comparisons. Suggested controlled design: share item embeddings, candidate scorer, loss, sampling, and history truncation across the three history controls; vary only aggregation—latest item, normalized uniform weights, or normalized exponential recency weights. Train each control independently. Allocate equal single-GPU tuning budgets, common checkpoint-selection rules, and a small declared decay grid; report GPU-seconds, parameters, and training steps because equal epochs do not imply equal compute. These recommendations address documented weak-baseline and unequal-tuning problems ([Dacrema et al.](https://ijcai.org/proceedings/2020/650)). Count failed trials and diagnostics against the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget. Repeated adaptive validation queries can overfit the holdout ([Dwork et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.02629)); cap comparisons, log all attempts, label post-selection intervals exploratory, and reserve confirmation for the host’s untouched final evaluation.
